scope: Fix the publication origin check after installed Next.js 16.2.11 normalizes loopback IPs to localhost.
production: Exact request-origin check preserved; loopback exception requires NODE_ENV and NEXT_PUBLIC_RUNTIME_MODE both development.
exception: Origin must be a canonical 127.0.0.1 or [::1] origin, normalized request hostname must be localhost, scheme and port must match, and Host must equal the origin authority. Forwarded headers never authorize the exception.

regressionBefore.failures: IPv4 and IPv6 NextRequest normalization both returned 403 instead of 400 before the fix.
